question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

We prefer going to movies __once in a blue moon__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Very rarely.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"once in a blue moon"** means something that happens very rarely. (बहुत ही कम)

 
 
• **Example: **I see my cousins who live abroad once in a blue moon.
 
 
 
• **"Very rarely"** refers to something that occurs infrequently or almost never. (बहुत ही कम)
 
 
• **Example: **He very rarely goes out to eat, preferring to cook at home.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Very rarely**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Very amazingly** (बहुत ही आश्चर्यजनक): Something that is extremely surprising or impressive.

 
 
• **Example:** The magician performed very amazingly, leaving the audience in awe.
 
 
 
• **Very diligently** (बहुत ही परिश्रमपूर्वक): Doing something with great care and perseverance.
 
 
• **Example: **She worked very diligently to complete her project on time.
 
 
 
• **Very often** (बहुत ही बार): Something that happens frequently or regularly.
 
 
• **Example:** He visits his grandparents very often, almost every weekend.
